questions.stem: A graph of $y = x^3 - 3x$ does not intersect the line $y = k$. What does this tell you about the equation $x^3 - 3x = k$?
questions.explanation: If the line $y = k$ does not intersect the curve, then there are no $x$-values satisfying $x^3 - 3x = k$, meaning the equation has no real solutions.
